# Required Pi 5 FAT boot files for the R8 evidence kit. Fields: path, minimum bytes, check.
# `scripts/pi5-serial.sh --check` reads this file with `mtype`; the checks are `config` (the
# proposed Pi 5 config.txt contract lines), `kernel` (non-zero `kernel_2712.img`), `fdt` (the
# big-endian 0xd00dfeed magic) and `none`.
#
# The Pi 5 EEPROM bootloader's exact required file set, the kernel_2712.img selection and the
# kernel load address remain UNVERIFIED; see docs/pi5-evidence.md.
config.txt 1 config
kernel_2712.img 65536 kernel
bcm2712-rpi-5-b.dtb 1024 fdt
start4.elf 1048576 none
fixup4.dat 1024 none
LICENCE.broadcom 1 none
